description: Working for the government of the republic of Zambia (GRZ) in the ministry of Agriculture and livestock as an extension methodologist.
As extension methodologist, I am involved in linking the governments extension officers to various stakeholders/organizations involved in Agriculture extension.
Worked as research assistant on staff work-force planning research.
Gained experience in handling of some statistical packages like SPSS.
Worked as an intern under research and policy section.
Participated in analysis and evaluation of various agricultural policies.

work_history.company: Conservation Farming Unity (CFU) & Independent Management Consultancy Services (IMCS)
description: Worked as an enumerator in the conservation farming phase 2 research survey.
Practically evaluated the skills of the local farmers in conservation farming.
Participated in the evaluation of acidulated rock phosphate as a source of phosphorous in broiler rations.
Chickens were reared under feed formulated using rock phosphate and compared with those under commercial feed.

english_level: Excellent in both spoken and written English.
matchmaking_summary: Ernest Mwale Mupemo is a highly motivated and skilled extension methodologist with extensive experience working for the government of Zambia, specifically within the ministry of Agriculture and livestock. His role involves coordinating with various stakeholders to improve agricultural services provision at district level. He has also worked as a research assistant and intern in reputable organizations like Plan Zambia and Agricultural Consultative Forum, gaining significant skills in data analysis and policy evaluation. With academic achievements including a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture from The University of Zambia, Mupemo demonstrates strong educational background and practical experience required for roles involving agricultural development and management.
